title: Masked Generative Motion Planning with Geometry-Guided Token Search
description:
arXiv:2610.10646v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Generative motion planners typically use learned trajectory priors for initial generation, while leaving test-time repair to local continuous refinement. We introduce Masked Generative Motion Planning (MGMP), which extends the learned prior from efficient parallel generation to structural repair.
